shortDescription: Syncronises user accounts from LDAP/Active directory to Oracle database and maps group membership to Oracle roles

options.name: deleted_user_mode
options.description: What action to take then user is not found in LDAP search anymore

options.name: group_role_map
options.description: Each user can be granted additional roles based on LDAP group membership, this parameter describes the relationship between group LDAP DN and Oracle group name Each list item must be DICT with elements dn and groups Example list item: {dn: "CN=prod_db_reader,OU=Security Groups,DC=domain,DC=int", group: "prod_db_reader"}

options.name: hostname
options.description: The Oracle database host

options.name: ldap_binddn
options.description: LDAP login username eg reader@domain.int

options.name: ldap_bindpassword
options.description: LDAP login password

options.name: ldap_connect
options.description: LDAP connect string eg ldap://domain.int:389

options.name: ldap_user_basedn
options.description: LDAP BASE DN for syncronised users

options.name: ldap_user_filter
options.description: LDAP filter to search for syncronised users

options.name: ldap_user_subtree
options.description: Is the entire subtree searched for users (true) or just one level (false)

options.name: ldap_username_attribute
options.description: LDAP attribute that is used for user name in Oracle If value does not "Oracle identifier" compatible, then this user is silently skipped

options.name: mode
options.description: The mode with which to connect to the database

options.name: password
options.description: The Oracle user password for 'user'

options.name: port
options.description: The listener port number on the host

options.name: service_name
options.description: The database service name to connect to

options.name: user
options.description: The Oracle user name to connect to the database, must have DBA privilege

options.name: user_default_password
options.description: Default password for newly created user Password is expired immediately Do not specify for EXTERNAL authentication_type

options.name: user_default_tablespace
options.description: Default tablespace for syncronised users

options.name: user_grants
options.description: List of all grants all syncronised users will get

options.name: user_profile
options.description: Profile for syncronised user Must be dedicated profile for this syncronization process, since this is               the only way to detect which users should be locked/dropped

options.name: user_quota_on_default_tbs_mb
options.displayName: User Quota On Default Tbs Mb
options.description: Quota in MB for the default tablespace Do not specify for unlimited quota

options.name: user_temp_tablespace
options.description: Temporary tablespace for syncronised user
